newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangnan says warrant issue approved.
newsitem.headline: Guangnan says warrant issue approved.

text.p: Food distributor Guangnan (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday its proposal to issue 145.36 million warrants at HK$0.35 each has been passed by shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting held on January 31.
Copies of listing document, provisional allotment letters and forms for application for excess warrants have been despatched to the qualifying shareholders, it said in a statement on Monday.
Each warrant entitles the holder the right to subscribe for one Guangnan share at an intial subscription price of HK$7.50 per share before the warrants expire on August 31, 1998.

The company said earlier more than 70 percent of the warrants would be offered to its shareholders on one-for-seven basis with the remaining to be placed with independent institutional and professional investors.
